intended_use: 15-second vertical launch film for a social feed.
premise: Prove light, touchable volume by placing the hairstyle under one elegant movement test.
end_state: The bottle and lifted hair settle into a clean shared frame while the line 'VOLUME THAT MOVES' appears, followed by a quiet product sound resolve.

references.role: Exact product geometry, cap, label, wordmark, and liquid color.
Warm directional light and restrained shadow softness only.
Hair movement rhythm and camera acceleration only; do not copy talent identity or setting.

continuity_locks: same fictional adult model hair color, length, texture, and styling across all shots
same bottle geometry, label, cap, and liquid color
warm-white studio and upper-left key light
hair remains lifted but touchable, never rigid

timeline.visual: Extreme close-up of a few lifted hair strands and the silver cap edge in warm light; the frame begins almost still.
timeline.action: A soft current of air begins and the strands respond gradually.
timeline.camera: Very slow macro push-in with stable focus and no cut.
timeline.audio: Quiet studio ambience, one subtle inhale-like air rise.

timeline.visual: Medium back-and-side view of the adult model in the warm minimal studio, product on a low pedestal in the foreground.
timeline.action: The model performs one controlled turn. Hair opens into a fluid arc, then remains visibly lifted as it moves.
timeline.camera: Track with the turn, then arc about 30 degrees around the subject; preserve product visibility and avoid frantic motion.
timeline.audio: Soft fabric movement and a restrained percussive pulse synchronized to the turn.

timeline.visual: The movement resolves into a vertical product-and-hair hero composition with clean copy space.
timeline.action: Hair settles naturally without collapsing; the bottle remains perfectly stable. The exact line appears: VOLUME THAT MOVES.
timeline.camera: Gentle pull back into the final locked frame; hold the last second.
timeline.audio: A quiet glass-like product click and warm low-frequency resolve; no voiceover.

environment.lighting: Warm upper-left directional key, controlled silver highlights, realistic hair translucency and contact shadows.
environment.materials: Natural hair fiber detail, transparent bottle, silver cap, amber liquid, matte warm-white set.
environment.physics: Hair movement follows inertia, gravity, air resistance, and the completed body turn; no impossible strand reversal or clipping.

dialogue_audio.ambience: Quiet premium studio room tone with subtle air movement.
dialogue_audio.music: Minimal restrained pulse that enters at 3 seconds and resolves under the final frame; original or properly licensed.

exclude: no extra text before the final line
no facial close-up or identifiable real person
no bottle deformation or label drift
inspection: Verify bottle and label fidelity in every visible frame.
Verify the same hair identity and styling across shots.
Verify motion, contact, inertia, and settling are physically plausible.
Verify camera path follows the timeline and final frame holds.
Verify exact final text and absence of accidental text.
Verify audio synchronization, rights status, and delivery specification.

rights.notes: Fictional assets, fictional adult model reference, original/licensed audio required.
